endorsements.name: Michael Hausding
endorsements.label: Take or Buy : Internet criminals domain names needs and what registries can do against it.
endorsements.description: As everyone who wants to run a business on the internet, criminals need domain names to operate their infrastructure. But unlike everyone they have two possibilities: They can take already registered domain names by compromising the DNS or other services, or they can simply register domain names. This talk will give an overview of the criminal use of domain names and how a registry operator can help to prevent internet crime and protect internet users from online fraud.
endorsements.subtitle: Insomni'hack 2018
